question: True or false: some people can raise gooseflesh on their skin at will, with no cold or emotion?
answer: True. Heathers and colleagues studied 32 people who could do it; most described a kind of inner tensing, often starting at the back of the head, and some could raise it on one side of the body only. As a group they scored higher than usual on openness to experience.
move: A reflex called involuntary is sometimes just one nobody has tried to steer.
trap: Assuming a nerve response outside conscious control can never be steered.
reference: Heathers et al., The voluntary control of piloerection, PeerJ, 2018
